hard_rules: UNKNOWN must never be coerced to NO
Legal classification must not depend on an LLM
Every legal result must include rule code and source reference
An Annex III match must not automatically bypass Article 6.3
Article 6.3 exclusion must not be auto-certified for a deployer when provider assessment is required
High-risk obligation dates must be resolved by HIGH_RISK_BASIS: Annex III -> 2027-12-02; Annex I -> 2028-08-02
Article 25 role transitions override a prior deployer/distributor/importer-only assumption for the affected high-risk system
FRIA must not be generated for every deployer; apply Article 27 eligibility conditions
Open-source exclusions must preserve Article 2.12 exceptions for high-risk, Article 5 and Article 50 systems
GPAI open-source exemption applies only to Article 53(1)(a)-(b) and never to systemic-risk models
